room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. Across the water, a light swings once and goes dark.
room.ferry_landing.waiting: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. Bram keeps glancing north, toward the green.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass.
npc.bram.room: [Bram] the ferryman stands here, one boot on the ferry.
npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry.
item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] lies in the weeds.
item.lantern.description: Dented brass, still smelling of oil. It would light a fen path.
quest.lantern.title: Bram's lantern
